notes: The registered row is POS_DEAD at level 0; a mortal descriptor can enter the handler (R2/R5e).
With no descriptor original body, C emits no bytes and does not invent a not-switched response.
C has no argument parsing; trailing input remains behaviorally irrelevant.
A switched descriptor receives exactly C's original-body message before descriptor reattachment.
The original player regains the descriptor relationship and the switched state is cleared; no save or extra player bytes are invented.
